title: HtmlLabel
responsibility: Renders the native label element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlLabel.attributes
inputs.description: Native label attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlLabel.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native label element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlLabel
outputs.description: The actual native label element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
